page_title: MON 2-1 HOF | B. Monchengladbach v Hoffenheim 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

90+6' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+5' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+1' Now B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by B. Monchengladbach.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Oliver Baumann sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
90' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
88' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
88' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) will replace Franck Honorat.
84' Substitution. Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) has come on for Alassane Plea.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Ngoumou trots off the pitch and is replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
84' Here is a change. Pavel Kaderabek is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
84' Substitution. Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) in, Ozan Kabak out.
83' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
82' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
80' 2 - 1 Goal! Luca Netz plays a pass to the feet of Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 2:1.

80' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Moritz Nicolas with a brilliant diving save!
79' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the left post.
77' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Here comes a substitution. Umut Tohumcu is given a rest as he is replaced by Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim).
71' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is first to react to a great cross from Marius Bulter, but slices his shot high over the bar from inside the box.
70' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
69' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

69' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Florian Neuhaus is replaced by Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach).
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:12. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:4.
63' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Moritz Nicolas.

60' 1 - 1 Umut Tohumcu produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box where Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) rises high to head the ball off the woodwork into the left side of the goal. The score is now - 1:1.
59' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) replacing Robert Skov.
59' That's the end of the game for Finn Ole Becker, who is replaced by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
58' 1 - 0 Goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Oliver Baumann into the bottom right corner.
58' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

58' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tobias Reichel signals. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
56' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
54' Gerardo Seoane is forced to make a change. Nico Elvedi is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
54' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) is given a yellow card.
52' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
50' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
50' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
46' The whistle blows and Tobias Reichel starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards goal and it goes just over the crossbar.
44' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

42' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) sends a long ball forward to Maximilian Beier, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
40' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and made an astonishing save!
37' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
37' Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
37' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
33' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) plays a terrific long ball forward to Pavel Kaderabek, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
31' Tobias Reichel interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach). A free kick has been awarded to Hoffenheim.
28' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
26' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
25' The total number of attempts is 0:5. The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
24' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) tries to find Maximilian Beier, but he puts too much power on the pass.
20' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but it's cleared.
20' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

19' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the roof of the net, but Moritz Nicolas gets a hand to it and keeps it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Hoffenheim.
19' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Maximilian Beier.
18' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
16' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul after Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) hacks down one of his opponents.
14' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for holding. Tobias Reichel signals a set piece.
11' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
9' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.
7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
4' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
3' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) tries to find Maximilian Beier, but he puts too much power on the pass.
1' Tobias Reichel couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) and blew his whistle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will referee today's match.
